descriptionChirho: A high-ranking military officer or adjutant, originally the 'third man' on a war chariot (warrior alongside driver and shield-bearer), later generalized to denote a captain or commander in the royal military apparatus.
A group of three, or 'the three' as a numeral designation, reflecting the underlying root שׁלשׁ ('three') in a context where the numeral rather than the military rank is foregrounded.
The numeral 'thirty,' a homographic form where the plural שְׁלִשִׁים is read as the cardinal number rather than as the plural of the officer title.
